findings.message: Entry params listaId, responsavelId, prioridade, prazo, status, titulo, page, name and somenteAtivos had no state. Added persisted states filtroListaId, filtroResponsavelId, filtroPrioridade, filtroPrazo, filtroStatus (array parsed from a comma-separated param), filtroTitulo, filtroPagina, filtroNomeMembro and filtroSomenteAtivos, with filter methods (selecionarLista, filtrarPorResponsavel, filtrarPorPrioridade, filtrarPorPrazo, filtrarPorStatus, buscarPorTitulo, limparFiltros). The contract input names the title filter 'titulo' and the due date 'prazo' (single date, not a range).

No public selection member existed for selectedTarefa (id) nor for the Lista selection. Added selecionarTarefa(id|null), which loads the record through qryDetalheTarefa, and selecionarLista(id|null) plus the getter lista (row of listas), since no query fetches a Lista by id.
cmdReatribuirTarefa has no <command>.input state. Added cmdReatribuirTarefaDraft (ReatribuirTarefaDraft, responsavelId) with setCmdReatribuirTarefaDraft; id and version come from the loaded tarefa.

cmdReatribuirTarefa and cmdCancelarTarefa return itemQuadro, which no state has as source. It is applied to tarefas by id (only when the row is loaded); it is removed when it no longer matches the situation or responsible filters. Board ordering, the page's hasMore and other filters (list, priority, due date, title) cannot be recomputed in the browser and may stay stale until the board is reloaded. The membros state is also not refreshed by the reassignment.
